# MAQDOOM'S Big Mall

> Menswear showroom near Charminar, Hyderabad, India, since 1895: wedding sherwanis, kurta sets, indo-westerns, suits, waistcoats, safas and pagdis, mojris, jewellery and fabrics (thaans), with same-day custom tailoring. MAHIB is its in-house label of hand-embroidered complete groom looks. Shop online at https://maqdoomsbigmall.com with delivery across India and abroad.

## Visit
- Address: 22-7-176, Moghalpura, Charminar East, Hyderabad, Telangana 500002, India
- Open every day, 9 am to 11 pm
- Phone and WhatsApp: +91 96104 15415
- Instagram: @maqdooms_bigmall, @mahib_by_moghnymaqdoom

## Shop
- [All products (Maqdoom's)](https://maqdoomsbigmall.com/shop): sherwanis, indo-westerns, bandhgalas, suits, waistcoats, kurta pajama sets, fabrics
- [MAHIB](https://maqdoomsbigmall.com/mahib): complete groom looks for Nikah, reception and walima; outfits, headwear, footwear, jewellery, accessories
- [Contact and directions](https://maqdoomsbigmall.com/contact)

## Good to know
- Same-day tailoring: measured in the showroom and tailored to fit, usually in about 4 hours.
- Video calls on WhatsApp to see fabric, embroidery and fit before ordering.
- Payment online or cash on delivery; loyalty points shared between the showroom and the website.
- [Shipping](https://maqdoomsbigmall.com/policies/shipping), [Exchanges and returns](https://maqdoomsbigmall.com/policies/returns), [Loyalty points](https://maqdoomsbigmall.com/policies/points)
